title: SaaS Dashboard
summary: First authenticated home that orients users to status, next actions, and navigation without drowning them in charts.

strategies.name: Action-first home
strategies.tradeoffs: Faster task completion vs weaker executive overview.
strategies.when: Operator tools where users return to do work, not browse metrics.

strategies.name: Metric-first executive view
strategies.tradeoffs: Great for leadership; paralyzes new IC users with numbers.
strategies.when: Analytics, revenue, or ops products with daily KPI rituals.

strategies.name: Setup checklist until aha
strategies.tradeoffs: Improves activation; feels naggy if checklist never ends.
strategies.when: Multi-integration SaaS that needs connected data to show value.

strategies.name: Role-personalized modules
strategies.tradeoffs: Higher relevance; harder to design and QA.
strategies.when: Products with distinct admin, manager, and member jobs.

forgottenStates: Mobile collapse of dense KPI grids
neverDo: Show demo charts pretending to be live data
Put six equal-priority cards competing for attention
Hide primary create action behind nested menus
Auto-play product tour on every login
Use purple gradient defaults with no brand signal
evidenceNotes: Compiled from captured app journeys + curated designer wisdom.
